text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - action-proxy cluster high error rate detected. p95 latency 4.2s, errors rising to 7%. Alert: ACTION_PROXY_ERR_HIGH. Paging oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/act-proxy/alerts

maria: Oncall here. Seeing the same. Spike started ~3412102400. Hitting external-exec path, downstream 503s.

vikram: Logs show repeated timeouts to third-party connectors and a surge of large structured payloads. Likely amplification from a few tenants.

jacob: I'm going to flip the proxy into minimal mode (drop external action execution, serve text-only responses + clear structured payloads). Posting command now.

jacob: ```
# admin control plane
redwood-admin services update action-proxy --set "mode=minimal" --reason "mitigate external-exec surge" --actor jacob
# feature flag
ffctl set allow_external_actions false --scope public --actor jacob
```

deploy-bot: Started job 3821: apply-config(action-proxy) by jacob. CI checks ok, rolling to 3/3 nodes.

maria: Apply it. Also lower tenant concurrency for non-enterprise to 1 to limit blowup. Sam will coordinate edge throttles.

sam: Adding an edge throttle rule now. Will rate-limit structured content header X-Struct-Payload for requests > 50 rps per tenant and return 429 with a short explanation. Command: ```
edgectl policy add --name throttle-struct --match "header:X-Struct-Payload" --rate 50
```

vikram: Snapshot of error stream after switch: small paste of logs:
```
[3412102510] PROXY->DOWNSTREAM timeout for tenant=acme-corp path=/exec structured=true
[3412102512] PROXY MODE minimal -> rejecting exec requests
[3412102520] RESPONSE 200 text-only (fallback) tenant=acme-corp
```

maria: Early numbers look good. p95 down to ~1.1s, errors ~1.2%. Keeping minimal mode for now. Oncall-manager, can CS start customer comms?

oncall-manager: Yes. Customer-success, please run the templated notification for impacted tenants and mark top 10 for phone outreach. Status page update in 10m.

customer-success: Sending notices now. Note in message that "external action execution and structured payloads are temporarily restricted; text responses remain available. We expect restoration within ~30 minutes." Will DM affected account owners.

jacob: Adding a fallback routing change so enterprise contracts still get routed to isolated cluster that allows execs (to preserve SLAs). Command: ```
redwood-admin route update action-proxy --route enterprise->isolated-cluster
```

vikram: Observability: set alert to auto-extend the mitigation if errors > 2% for 3m. If so, we escalate to infra and consider circuit-breaker for the offending tenants.

maria: Agreed. Also start a quick postmortem note in #incidents once we stabilize. Who wants to own triage? Vikram and Jacob to pair. Sam to collect edge throttle metrics.

sam: Got it. I'll record the throttle hit-rates and a list of top offenders.

deploy-bot: Job 3821 complete: action-proxy mode=minimal applied to 3/3 nodes. no rollback.

maria: Thanks. Monitoring for 20m, then we'll attempt a controlled re-enable (canary 5% of traffic to normal mode). If p95 stays <1.5s and errors <0.5% for 5m, proceed.

vikram: Setting canary plan in runbook. If regression occurs revert ffctl allow_external_actions true -> false toggle, and route all traffic to text-only fallback.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria. Severity: Sev2. Current status: mitigation active.

maria: Closing loop: minimal-mode + edge throttle reduced error rate and latency. Keeping mitigation until further notice. I'll update when we start the canary. :white_check_mark:
